_comment: Personas whose approved voice may render LESSON audio (lesson_audio.py).
A persona not listed here is unvoiced: its parts of a lesson wait, and
every other part of the same lesson still renders (owner, 2026-10-16).
Each entry names the locked reference clip in the private agent repo
and its sha256; the render refuses a clip whose hash differs. f0 values
are the median-F0 gate (qc.py), the same ones the standing-line batches
under voice_batches/inbox/ use for that voice. Add a persona only once
the owner has approved its voice. Same-source rule: personas sharing a
voice_family never share a lesson (checked per lesson, from the voice
specs); Voice A never renders Grade R-3.
assistant_005 (Kavitha) is deliberately absent: she hosts Grades R-3 only
(owner, 2026-10-16), although the assistants roster still maps her to Grade 9.
